wireContract: Retains genuine134 operations and adds browser-session-only DeleteVideoPost: DELETE /posts/:postId/video, no request body, returning object video_post_deletion, community_id, post_id and status deleted. The authenticated account must own the published, hidden, removed or already-deleted video Post. Repeating the immutable target returns the same removal receipt. Non-video and other-author targets are not found; unpublished videos conflict. Normal Origin and CSRF protections apply. This removes the public Post and new access authority; it does not promise immediate erasure of provider assets or revocation of previously issued Stream grants.
